name: delegated_decision
title: Delegates the decision instead of choosing
regex: \b(your call|you decide|whatever you (?:think|prefer)|up to you|your (?:recommendation|judg(?:e)?ment)|i'll leave (?:it|that) to you|do what you think is best)\b
action: Give one recommendation, not a menu of options to choose from

positive: ok, your call — just go with it
up to you, whatever you think is best
negative: I'll take option 2, not variant B
let's check the tests first before deciding

name: correction
title: Corrects the assistant, without expecting an apology
regex: \b(that'?s not right|that isn'?t right|that is not right|that'?s wrong|you missed|you didn'?t|that didn'?t work|still (?:broken|failing|wrong)|not what i asked|you misunderstood)\b
action: Accept the correction and keep working — no apology loop

positive: that's not right, you missed the second file
still broken — not what I asked for
negative: can you explain how this works?

name: pasted_terminal_output
title: Pasted terminal output merged with the prompt
action: Read the start of the message as pasted terminal output, not as an instruction

positive:
user@host:~$ ls -la
drwxr-xr-x 3 root root 4096 Sep 26 .

user@host ~/project $ git status
On branch main
negative: can you check the status please?

name: non_default_language
title: Message carries no signal word of the configured default language
action: Keep quoted technical terms verbatim; do not switch the reply language automatically

positive: veuillez vérifier les journaux et me dire ce qui s'est passé
por favor revisa los registros y dime qué pasó
negative: please check the logs and tell me what happened
your help would be appreciated, thanks
